decisions.text: Travel to Lisbon by train, not by plane.
decisions.rationale: Lower carbon, and the journey is part of the trip.
Close to the sights and full of character.

constraints.text: No more than 10,000 steps a day.

tasks: Book the night train from Paris

memories.text: Travelling with a partner who dislikes crowds.

history.content: Planning a week in Lisbon. Fly or train?
Flying is quicker; the train via Paris and Hendaye takes about two days but is lower carbon and scenic.
Alfama is atmospheric and central; Baixa is flatter; Belém is quieter but further out.
